title: Three streams, three files
summary: In a child: stdin from a file, stdout and stderr to two others, then exec.
hints: Do all the work in the CHILD, between `fork` and `exec`: open, `dup2` onto 0, 1 or 2, then `close` the original descriptor.
Input: `O_RDONLY`. Outputs: `O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC`, mode `0644`. Redirect standard error LAST, so that if an `open` fails the message can still reach the real standard error.
Wait with `waitpid` and decode with `WEXITSTATUS`. If a file cannot be opened the child ends with status 1 and does not run the command.
